integrity: The infinite statement is proved from exact neighborhood traces. Exhaustive enumeration through order 10 is a regression check only and is not used as a substitute for proof.
limitations: The theorem is specific to connected threshold graphs in canonical alternating block form.
Outside the twin-thick subfamily, the all-cardinality polynomial is left as an explicit admissible-pair sum rather than compressed to a constant-state recurrence.
Older or weakly indexed work under creation-sequence, nested-neighborhood, or split-graph terminology could still contain overlapping special cases.
title: Locating-dominating sets of threshold graphs by canonical omissions
